1. Remove the two clips (1a) and (1b) securing the protective gaiter (1c).

3. Withdraw the joint from the drive shaft and then remove the protective gaiter.

Wash the joint thoroughly using diesel or petrol, and visually check that there are no signs of seiaure or scoring on the balls and their seats.

Fit the new protective gaiter.

Fill the gaiter and joint with specific TUTELA MR2 grease.
